fact: The preliminary study presented at the national validation workshop of 25 March 2026 surveyed 37 civil registration centres, where births, marriages and deaths are recorded in paper registers, and found fewer than half with stable electricity and only one centre in five with internet access; the proposed eCRVS system is to start with a pilot phase in three centres, Moroni, Mutsamudu and Fomboni, before expansion to all centres.
title: Une révolution numérique se prépare pour l’état civil
